description.para: Register offsets for the XSpi device.
This register holds the interrupt status flags for the Spi device.

This register enables interrupt sources for the Spi device. Writing a '1' to a bit in this register enables the corresponding Interrupt. Writing a '0' to a bit in this register disables the corresponding Interrupt.
ISR/IER registers have the same bit definitions and are only defined once.

detaileddescription.para: We add the TX_EMPTY interrupt in later when we're getting ready to transfer data. The others we don't care about for now.

The default data format is MSB first. The LSB first data format is not available in all versions of the Xilinx Spi Device whereas the MSB first data format is supported by all the versions of the Xilinx Spi Devices. Check the HW specification to see if this feature is supported or not.
